Directed by Siddharth Anand, the film also stars Deepika Padukone, Rani Mukerji, Anil Kapoor, Abhishek Bachchan, Jaideep Ahlawat, Arshad Warsi and Suhana Khan in pivotal roles. It will be released in theatres on December 24, clashing with Nagarjuna’s Telugu actioner, King100, which releases on the same day. Both the films will also be facing tough competition from two major Hollywood releases, Dune: Part Three and Avengers: Doomsday, which are going to be released on December 18.
